summary: A regeneration must keep cercaNeiMOP reading the column schema once per MOP family instead of once per regional dataset, falling back to the dataset's own columns when a borrowed schema makes the row query fail.
reason: A search by CIG hits twenty-one gare datasets plus twenty-one partecipanti datasets, and each one used to cost two requests, one for the obfuscated column ids and one for the rows. The regional datasets of a family have identical column sets, identifiers included (verified across all forty-two), so the schema call is pure duplication: dropping it halves the traffic (9.4s to 4.9s with pacing disabled). The per-dataset fallback keeps the result correct if a partition ever diverges.
validated_outcome: 'cig 57106934F1 --no-cache' returns the same single result as before in 18.4s instead of 23.3s, and 4.9s instead of 9.4s with --rate-limit 0.
